independence_declaration.statement: In this run qa-verifier authored no product implementation in the DG6 scope and changed no candidate file. The product (apps/**, packages/**, migrations, deploy/**, ADRs) was written by the implementer roles listed. The candidate's acceptance suites under tests/qa/** and e2e/** were written before the freeze by earlier qa-verifier authoring tasks (T-DG6-QA-A to H); they are tests, not implementation, and I judged them here as a reviewer: re-run, read against their clauses, and probed beyond them with my own tests, which stay outside the candidate under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG6/qa/tests/round-1/. Every build and test ran in disposable clones under $TMPDIR, removed at the end. I formed this verdict and wrote my findings (18:10Z) without reading any other reviewer's round-1 record; at the end-of-run identity check (18:30Z) git log showed the subject lines of the other reviewers' auto-committed evidence, and I opened none of their records.

summary: FAIL. On candidate sha256:7d6b4a9f (2708 files, source 3cce3d4, identity verified at start and end) every executable suite ran: static 7/7, unit 4 x EXIT 0, integration twice over all 410 files, tests/qa alone, root acceptance, product journeys and demo specs in en and ar in both locale settings, validators 7 x PASS. Every test passed in a full run or when re-run alone; the failures were renderer crashes and budget timeouts on a host shared by three reviews (load up to 33), and each is explained. My probes closed most of the disclosed partial clauses (keyboard walkthrough, Arabic export literals, a real validation error in Arabic, connector counts on screen, browser storage, 1440 px with data, AUD read-only, reflow). They also found four Medium findings that D-192 does not allow to be accepted as observations: F-DG6-140, the stale-data exception is never raised once a later period is open (REQ-S12-019); F-DG6-141, the export and import-upload rate-limit classes are not wired (REQ-S16-030); F-DG6-142, the in-tree load generator writes ids the API refuses (REQ-S20-029); F-DG6-147, 50 simultaneous export starts miss 2 s even on an idle-criterion host, 38 of 50 (REQ-S20-030). There are also four Low findings: F-DG6-143 (Upload policy overflows at 360 px in en), F-DG6-144 and F-DG6-145 (load-sensitive tests), and F-DG6-146 (createTomGap 422 instead of the uniform 400).
